title: Headphones with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Headband -->
  <path d="M22 52 Q22 18 50 18 Q78 18 78 52" fill="none" stroke="#FF6B6B" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Headband highlight -->
  <path d="M22 52 Q22 20 50 20 Q78 20 78 52" fill="none" stroke="#FF9B9B" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Left ear cup -->
  <ellipse cx="20" cy="58" rx="14" ry="17" fill="#FF6B6B"/>
  <ellipse cx="20" cy="58" rx="10" ry="13" fill="#FF4444"/>
  <!-- Left ear cushion -->
  <ellipse cx="20" cy="58" rx="7" ry="10" fill="#FFD4D4"/>
  
  <!-- Right ear cup -->
  <ellipse cx="80" cy="58" rx="14" ry="17" fill="#FF6B6B"/>
  <ellipse cx="80" cy="58" rx="10" ry="13" fill="#FF4444"/>
  <!-- Right ear cushion -->
  <ellipse cx="80" cy="58" rx="7" ry="10" fill="#FFD4D4"/>
  
  <!-- Face area between cups -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="60" rx="26" ry="20" fill="#FFE066"/>
  
  <!-- Left eye -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="55" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#2D1B4E"/>
  <ellipse cx="41.5" cy="53" rx="2" ry="2.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Right eye -->
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="55" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#2D1B4E"/>
  <ellipse cx="61.5" cy="53" rx="2" ry="2.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M40 68 Q50 78 60 68" fill="none" stroke="#2D1B4E" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Blush left -->
  <ellipse cx="33" cy="64" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#FF8FA3" opacity="0.8"/>
  
  <!-- Blush right -->
  <ellipse cx="67" cy="64" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#FF8FA3" opacity="0.8"/>
  
  <!-- Decorative stars on headband -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="30" r="2.5" fill="#FFD93D"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="24" r="2.5" fill="#FFD93D"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="30" r="2.5" fill="#FFD93D"/>
  
  <!-- Small sparkle on left cup -->
  <path d="M14 48 L16 52 L20 48 L16 44 Z" fill="#FFD93D"/>
  
  <!-- Small sparkle on right cup -->
  <path d="M80 44 L82 48 L86 44 L82 40 Z" fill="#FFD93D"/>
</svg>
